name: CandlePatternsExample
summary: This EA demonstrates the use of MQL5 built-in candlestick pattern recognition classes from the Standard Library. It detects classic Japanese candlestick patterns (Engulfing, Harami, Hammer, Doji Star, etc.) and automatically opens buy or sell positions based on the identified pattern signals, using fixed lot sizes and configurable stop-loss/take-profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA演示了如何使用MQL5标准库中的K线形态识别类来检测经典的日本蜡烛图形态（吞没形态、十字星、锤子线等），并根据识别到的形态信号自动开立多头或空头仓位，使用固定手数和可配置的止损/止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是基于经典的日本K线形态识别进行交易决策，利用MQL5标准库中的CCandlePattern及其派生类来检测多种反转和持续形态。入场条件为：当检测到看涨K线形态（如看涨吞没、晨星、锤子线）时开多仓，当检测到看跌K线形态（如看跌吞没、暮星、上吊线）时开空仓。出场条件依赖固定的止损和止盈设置，没有动态追踪止损机制。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，不根据账户余额或风险比例动态调整。资金管理方面较为简单，没有最大持仓限制或回撤控制机制。整体策略属于经典的形态识别交易方法，适合用于学习MQL5的EA开发框架和模式识别类的使用方法。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on classic Japanese candlestick pattern recognition for trading decisions, leveraging the CCandlePattern class and its derivatives from the MQL5 Standard Library to detect multiple reversal and continuation patterns. Entry conditions: long positions are opened when bullish candlestick patterns (such as bullish engulfing, morning star, hammer) are detected, and short positions are opened when bearish patterns (such as bearish engulfing, evening star, hanging man) are identified. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels with no dynamic trailing stop mechanism. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account balance or risk ratios. Money management is simplistic, lacking maximum position limits or drawdown control mechanisms. The overall strategy represents a classical pattern recognition trading approach, best suited for learning MQL5 EA development frameworks and pattern recognition class usage.

parameters.name: CandlePatternType
parameters.description: 选择使用的K线形态类型

pros: 利用MQL5标准库的形态识别类，代码结构清晰规范，是优秀的学习范例
涵盖多种经典K线形态，策略逻辑直观易懂，便于理解和扩展
基于标准库实现，可复用性强，便于在此基础上开发更复杂的形态识别策略
代码模块化程度高，形态检测与交易逻辑分离，架构合理
pros_en: Leverages MQL5 Standard Library pattern recognition classes with clean, well-structured code serving as an excellent learning example
Covers multiple classic candlestick patterns with intuitive and easy-to-understand strategy logic for easy comprehension and extension
Built on the Standard Library for high reusability, making it convenient to develop more complex pattern recognition strategies on this foundation
High degree of code modularity with pattern detection and trading logic properly separated, providing sound architecture
cons: 固定手数没有动态仓位管理，无法根据市场波动或账户风险自适应调整
缺乏多重过滤机制，仅依赖单一K线形态信号容易产生频繁的虚假信号
没有回撤控制或最大持仓限制，在连续亏损时风险暴露较大
止损止盈为固定点数，未考虑ATR等波动性指标进行动态调整
作为示例EA，策略实盘效果有限，缺乏足够的实盘验证和优化
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing without dynamic position management cannot adapt to market volatility or account risk
Lacks multi-layer filtering mechanisms; relying solely on single candlestick pattern signals easily generates frequent false signals
No drawdown control or maximum position limits, leading to significant risk exposure during consecutive losses
Stop-loss and take-profit use fixed pip values without considering ATR or other volatility indicators for dynamic adjustment
As a sample EA, its live trading performance is limited, lacking sufficient real-market verification and optimization
improvements: 增加多时间框架确认和多指标过滤（如趋势方向、成交量确认），减少虚假信号
引入基于ATR的动态止损止盈和根据账户风险比例的动态仓位管理
添加回撤控制机制和最大同时持仓限制，提升资金管理安全性
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation and multi-indicator filtering (e.g., trend direction, volume confirmation) to reduce false signals
Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop-loss/take-profit and risk-ratio-based dynamic position sizing
Add drawdown control mechanisms and maximum simultaneous position limits to enhance money management safety

risk_points: 单一K线形态信号容易产生虚假交易，缺乏多维度确认
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动性，在高波动行情中止损可能过小
没有回撤控制或最大持仓限制机制
risk_points_en: Single candlestick pattern signals easily generate false trades without multi-dimensional confirmation
Fixed stop-loss/take-profit ignores market volatility; stops may be too tight during high-volatility conditions
No drawdown control or maximum position limit mechanisms in place
